    - https://bugs.python.org/issue8557
    - windows does not parse shebangs

    This function also makes deep-path shebangs work just fine

        # Fix issue #8557, "Python fails to recognize shebang line on Windows"

        cmd[0] = cmd[0].replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")

        # Fix shebang not being parsed on Windows

    return cmd
